records.explanation: The warehouse has no credit score column or credit-rating data in any table; it only holds invoices, payments, deals, orders and receivables aging.
No table has a salesperson or owner column: stg_deals has won/lost flags and close dates but no user, so deals can't be attributed to a salesperson.
Gross margin needs cost of goods sold or product cost data, and the warehouse only holds revenue-side data (deals, orders, invoices, payments), so it can't be calculated.
The warehouse has no support ticket data (only deals, orders, invoices, payments, partners), so ticket counts for Acme Corporation can't be answered.

The warehouse has no billing schedule, subscription or recurring-invoice plan, or planned invoice dates, so it cannot say what will be billed in November 2026. It only holds invoices already issued and orders and deals without billing timing.
